findings.issue: Ten lemmas are exact instantiations of same-PR lemmas at `F := (mfderiv … ).toLinearMap`, with no mathematical content and no hypothesis of the namespace they sit in: `IsPseudoholomorphicAt.mfderiv_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_{nonneg,eq_zero_iff,pos_iff,pos}` (262, 270, 280, 289), `IsPseudoholomorphicWithinAt.mfderivWithin_…_{nonneg,eq_zero_iff,pos_iff,pos}` (325, 333, 343, 353), and `SmoothTwoForm.Compatible.two_mul_twoForm_{mfderiv,mfderivWithin}_le_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity` (431, 442). Each body is literally `htame.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_… (u z) _` / `hcompat.two_mul_twoForm_le_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity (u z) _`; `u`, `s`, `z` are never constrained, so they are the density lemmas with a term plugged in.

summary: The manifold lifting itself is new and correctly reuses the linear theory through `IsNondegenerate.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_eq`, but the PR adds ten zero-content wrapper lemmas that only substitute `mfderiv`/`mfderivWithin` into same-PR lemmas, reproves Mathlib's `mfderiv_const`, and repeats the same two-form antisymmetry/linearity plumbing three times instead of factoring it.
